_comment: Starting loadout roll and the run's item catalog (LoadoutConfig in core/include/rm/content.h). Each run spends budget points: one weapon from the skin or character starting_weapons list (cost by weapon category), then random equipment until the points run out, adding at most max_items distinct entries (the RE5 inventory has nine slots and the character's own weapons, ammo, knife and spray already take most of them); unspent points become starting supplies. game_item is the RE5 inventory id ((category << 8) | index; category 1 = weapons and grenades, 3 = recovery items), written to the game inventory at match start. price (supplies) puts the item in the shop and the arena rewards (bundle = units per reward); items without a game_item stay run-only and are never sold.
